title: Source compatibility audit: Photo World dev21 against current Maths and Physics
summary: A static symbol-presence audit finds the Maths surface used by Photo World dev21 still present in canonical Maths v0.19; dev21 has no direct Physical* class dispatch. This is source evidence only, not runtime qualification.
maths_v0_19_findings: Canonical Maths.cls still declares MathContext, MathMatrix, MathAngle and MathVector3.
Canonical Maths.cls still declares class methods defaultContext, sqrt, atan, atan2, tan, cos, sin, matrix, vector and MathAngle~degrees.
Canonical Maths.cls still declares matrix solve and Vector3 normalized operations used by Photo World.
Symbol presence does not prove unchanged argument contracts, numeric semantics or provider behaviour; Photo World regressions must still execute against v0.19.
physics_dev50_2_findings: No direct .Physical* class dispatch was found in the current Photo World dev21 Rexx source tree.
The dev21 compatibility lock already states Physics is a pinned peer not exercised by the dev21 regressions.
Therefore current Photo World source has no direct Physics call surface to recompile, but future coupled survey constraints still require explicit Physics integration qualification.
remaining_gates: Execute Photo World regressions with canonical Maths v0.19 and compare numerical results/precision evidence.
Do not promote Physics dev50.2 into the Photo World compatibility lock until its relevant integration semantics are exercised.
Migrate Python-provider crossings separately through the upstream ooRexxPython adapter; this audit says nothing about that runtime boundary.
